readme: A clinic that does not exist, used to demonstrate this agent. Every exam, room and price here is invented. It is deliberately not a tidy catalogue: several entries are here because they break an assumption the code would otherwise be free to make.
name: Example Clinic

exams.name: MRI knee
exams.note: Wants both a side and a contrast, so the agent has to ask twice before it can look.

exams.name: X-ray knee
exams.note: Here so that the word knee names two exams. An agent that picks one is wrong half the time.

exams.name: X-ray chest
exams.note: Has no side. Asking which one is how an agent sounds like a form.

exams.name: Ultrasound abdomen
exams.note: The one people name in three completely different ways.

exams.name: MRI whole spine
exams.note: Longer than some of the sessions in the diary, so it cannot be offered everywhere the room is free.

exams.name: CT angiography
exams.unbookable_reason: a doctor has to approve the contrast dose first
exams.note: In the catalogue so it can be found and explained. Hiding it makes the clinic look as if it does not do it.

exams.name: Mammogram
exams.note: The only exam in its modality, in the only room that does it: when that room is busy there is no second choice.
